caption: The video captures a stage performance with a central female dancer in a white strappy outfit flanked by two shirtless male dancers holding flaming fan props. A projected backdrop of blue, pink, and orange cloud-like mountains fills the stage while flames burn along the floor. The woman stands with her back partly to the camera, one arm extended toward the dancer on the right, keeping a thin line taut between her hand and his raised fan. As she holds the line, a broad jet of flame bursts horizontally near the right dancer's hand while smoke drifts across the stage. The woman then rotates into profile facing left, shifting her weight and stance as the framing widens to reveal more of both dancers. She reaches across with extended arms to pull a thin line toward the dancer on the left, whose fan props remain lit. A large flame jet erupts from the left dancer as she lifts one arm and extends the other outward.
